name: robots/hybridrobotics__isaac_berkeley_humanoid
title: Berkeley Humanoid rough-terrain velocity task (Isaac Lab)
intro: Berkeley Humanoid rough-terrain velocity task (Isaac Lab), adapted from hybridrobotics/isaac_berkeley_humanoid. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
